scenes.basis: 9:1 "entered into a boat, and crossed over, and came into his own city" - his city is Capernaum (4:13)
9:9 "As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office" - at Capernaum, no departure narrated
9:23 "When Jesus came into the ruler's house" - still in his own city (9:1)
9:27-28 "As Jesus passed by from there... he had come into the house" - still in Capernaum
9:35 "Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues"
